messages:
finance-ops: FYI — Xelara (acct XLR-72) flagged a billing discrepancy on the Feb retainer. They were charged the reserved capacity line twice. Asking for a retroactive credit and confirmation of adjusted invoice.

finance-ops: Invoice snippet pasted below. Can someone confirm this is a duplicate line and advise next steps?

finance-ops: ```
Invoice: INV-2025-02-3487
Line items:
- Reserved GPUs (Feb) : $12,000
- Reserved GPUs (Feb) : $12,000  <-- duplicate
- Usage overage : $850
Subtotal: $24,850
Tax: $0
Total: $24,850
```

michael: I can take this. tagging @elaine for approval on a manual goodwill/retro credit. :eyes:

billing-bot: Created billing ticket BILL-4821 for INV-2025-02-3487 and linked to customer XLR-72.

elaine: Reviewed — yes looks like a duplicate reserved line. Approve issuing a credit equal to the duplicate reserved charge ($12,000). Also recommend waiving late fee if customer pushed back.

finance-ops: @elaine approved. Confirm GL code to post the credit?

elaine: Use GL-CREDIT-RETRO and tag department code FIN-OPS-02. Approve courtesy credit and refunding overpayment via account credit (no ACH refund unless requested).

account-manager-jordan: Noted — I'll inform the customer that we will apply a $12,000 account credit and update their invoice. They prefer a credit on account. :thumbsup:

michael: @sophie can you raise the journal entry and update AR? Please include reference BILL-4821 and INV-2025-02-3487.

sophie: On it, creating JE now. Will post JE id and update AR once done. ETA 2h.

billing-bot: JE created: JE-8259 (status: pending approval). Linked to BILL-4821.

sophie: JE-8259 posted, AR adjusted, credit applied to customer account. Updated invoice INV-2025-02-3487 to show credit line and new balance $12,850.

finance-ops: Thanks all. @account-manager-jordan please confirm customer received updated invoice and is OK with account credit. Close BILL-4821 when confirmed.

account-manager-jordan: Customer confirmed via email this morning and accepted the account credit. Closing ticket now. :white_check_mark:

finance-ops: Ticket closed. Logging this as a process defect — engineering follow-up to prevent duplicate reserved charge. Filing a probe with eng-infra.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4821 closed by account-manager-jordan.

sophie: JE reference: JE-8259 posted to GL-CREDIT-RETRO. Documentation uploaded to billing drive under XLR-72/INV-2025-02-3487.
